o1.biggest_mistake: Some break-even lines, especially ASC, are a little too generous and the under-spend/reserve plan is more conservative than the brief likely expected.

reason: Output 1 is the one I would rather hand to the team because it acts on the real money signals and is tougher about not scaling loss-making spend. Output 2 is good, but it compromises too much with Meta-reported profit and leaves more budget in marginal ad sets.
